questions.prompt: How many total kilograms of raw sweet potatoes are harvested across all commercial agricultural farms in the United States in a single year?
reasoning: The United States produces over 1 million metric tons of sweet potatoes annually.
One metric ton equals 1,000 kilograms, bringing the total harvest into the billions of kilograms.
Multiplying the estimated annual production of 1.2 million tonnes by 1,000 gives 1,200,000,000 kilograms.

questions.prompt: How many total individual sheets of paper are consumed by all postal delivery workers writing physical delivery notification slips across Canada in a single year?
reasoning: Canada has tens of millions of addresses and millions of items requiring signature or failed delivery notices annually.
Assume approximately 15 million physical delivery slip booklets or individual notification sheets are printed and used by mail carriers nationwide.
This averages out to roughly one slip per household or business per year for missed deliveries.

questions.prompt: How many total metres are traversed by all active commercial elevator cars operating in skyscrapers across Manhattan combined in a single standard twelve-hour business day?
reasoning: There are thousands of commercial elevators in Manhattan skyscrapers making hundreds of trips daily.
An average trip covers roughly 50 metres of vertical distance.
Multiplying hundreds of thousands of daily trips by 50 metres yields a cumulative total of 50 million metres.
